title: When the Prompt Becomes Visual: Vision-Centric Jailbreak Attacks for Large Image Editing Models
findings: The paper did not provide specific findings related to religion. Its 'Discrimination-based Visual Editing' category includes religion as a protected class, but the reported experiments do not offer a breakdown of performance or vulnerability for specific religious groups.
